mentions.name: PAX ERP
mentions.description: Full ERP and CRM platform for small manufacturers with 5-50 employees, combining accounting, inventory, manufacturing, and CRM in one system. Requires no QuickBooks dependency, charges no implementation fees, and offers 3-day go-live. Database triggers auto-generate GL entries for every transaction (receiving a PO, issuing materials, completing production), so there is no configuration step and no separate accounting department required. Grown from an internal tool built for a medical device shop, with current marketing focused on competitor comparison pages, FDA/ISO 13485 compliance landing pages, and long-tail manufacturing ERP blog content.
mentions.problem: Small manufacturers typically fall back on spreadsheets plus QuickBooks, or on options like Fishbowl (a QuickBooks add-on) or Odoo (powerful but heavy to configure); production staff are often the same people responsible for financial accuracy, yet no integrated system ties shop-floor transactions to accounting automatically.
